card.name: Punctuation before an abbreviation or new entry
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a space right after a name, citation or list item, just before an acronym or a new entry begins (e.g. an opening parenthesis before POR, NORD, GOODS, or a period ending a reference).

modes.label: Parenthesis before acronym
modes.description: An opening bracket after a full organization or project name, where the acronym comes next.
modes.example: National Organization for Rare Disorders<< (>>NORD), a federation of voluntary health

modes.label: Period ending a reference
modes.description: A period after page numbers or a citation, before the next entry starts.
modes.example: Revue gesamten Hydrobiologia, v. 70, no. 4, p. 575-589<<. >>Baillie, P.W.,

modes.label: Comma in a drug list
modes.description: A comma in an alphabetical list of drug names.
modes.example: CYP3A4 alprazolam, amiodarone, amlodipine, amprenavir, aprepitant<<,>> atorvastatin, ataz
